source_pages: printed p.211-212 / PDF 213-214 (subset extracted: p.211 whole; p.212 deferred)
family_naming_note: The catalog calls this family 'H. 36' inside the wall chapter, and calls a DIFFERENT family 'H. 36' nowhere else - but H.48, H.60, H.84 and H.96 name both a base family and a wall family. The registry merges section files by family NAME, so wall families are namespaced 'Wall H.xx' to keep two unrelated families from merging into one. The catalog's own wording is preserved in 'section'.
extraction_note: printed p.211, now WHOLE - all three opening kinds. The push-up type was held back on 2026-08-18 for want of a drawing convention; on 2026-08-20 that was judged the wrong shape of blocker. The codes are catalog FACT and the missing symbol is a drawing question, so the data ships and front_layout carries a mechanism with NO hinge_axis - 70_symbols draws a leaf only when told an axis, so nothing is drawn rather than something wrong. Same treatment as base_pull_out_door on printed p.36. printed p.212 (compound units) is still deferred - internal partitions are new geometry.

data.mounting_note: Catalog-level fact: every unit in the wall chapter hangs. HOW HIGH it hangs is not in the catalog and is not here - the generator takes it from Standards::WALL_MOUNT_BOTTOM_MM, a project default awaiting M1.6, and writes it onto the object as mount_bottom_mm (Contract v1.5).
data.n_elle_note: Each wall page carries a second elevation labelled 'N- Elle' at H + 2,2 (38,2 here). N_Elle is its own chapter, printed p.321. RECORDED, NOT IMPLEMENTED: the +22 mm belongs to that front programme and must not be baked into this family's height.

wall_top_hung_door.description: Wall unit with top-hung door - 1 top-hung door
wall_top_hung_door.notes: The page lists Servo Drive mechanism and Power adapter as surcharges. They are NOT recorded as companion_refs: the page prices them but gives them no article code, and inventing one would break the rule that a companion is resolved from the registry, never typed. Open for Elda.

front_layout.note: One door covering the full front, hinged along its top edge. Symbol: the mirror of the bottom-hung figure - base on the top edge, apex at the bottom, plan rectangle identical.

wall_bottom_hung_door.description: Wall unit with bottom-hung door - 1 bottom-hung door
wall_bottom_hung_door.notes: Same width set as the top-hung type. The page states no Push-pull device for this type and no interior configuration.

front_layout.note: Hinged along its bottom edge - the same figure already built for the laundry unit and the dishwasher panel.

wall_push_up_door.description: Wall unit with push-up door - 1 push-up door - interior Valencia handle - no Push-pull device
wall_push_up_door.notes: Narrower width set than the other two types on this page: W.60-120, with no W.45. Extracted as DATA with no opening symbol, decided 2026-08-20 - see extraction_note. The page lists Valencia handle 23, Servo Drive mechanism 554 and Power adapter 224 as surcharges with no article code; not recorded as companion_refs (Elda Q8).

front_layout.note: One full-front leaf carried by a push-up mechanism. Deliberately NO hinge_axis: the travel is not a swing about an edge and the catalog does not state it. Drawing rule owed in docs/Drawing_Spec_v0.1.md.
